n01.roman: Raji: An Ancient Epic. Pune ke Nodding Heads studio ka game, Mahabharat-Ramayan se inspired.

n02.roman: Ek ladki, Raji, raakshason se insaanon ko bachaati hai, aur apne bhai Golu ko dhoondhti hai.

n03.roman: Twist: Kickstarter fail! Founders ne savings se team ko salary di, aur co-founder Shruti Ghosh ne apna flat bech diya.

n04.roman: Phir Unreal Dev Grant mila. Team? Sirf 13 log, paanch deshon se.

n05.roman: 2020 mein Switch, phir PC, PS4 aur Xbox par launch. Aur The Game Awards mein, Best Debut Indie Game ka nomination!
